info.description: The REST API of the ExponetDB Control Plane: the read endpoints defined in Wave 1, the access, plan and approval endpoints of Wave 3A, the delegation endpoints of Wave 3B, the registry, schema, health and finding endpoints of Wave 4, and the node, migration, data-read and Control Plane endpoints of Waves 5 to 8. x-exponetdb-wave names the wave that contracted an operation. This document lists every contracted operation; an operation the running release does not serve yet answers 404 NOT_FOUND (application/problem+json) until it does. Errors are application/problem+json (RFC 9457) with the ExponetDB error catalog. Observed state carries source and observedAt; a failed live read is an error, never an empty list. A request carries exactly one credential: a Web App session (the __Host-exdb_session cookie; mutating requests also need X-CSRF-Token and the exact Origin), an OAuth access token for the audience https://db.exponet.cloud/api, or an API key of a service account. 401 and 403 answers carry a WWW-Authenticate Bearer challenge with resource_metadata (RFC 9728).
